messages:
Nina (AE): Quick sync — SigmaCorp wants a 30-day POC but procurement insisted on a short orderform + a vendor-signed HSM attestation before countersign. They also asked if we can invoice quarterly for a 3-month reserved commit.
Carlos (Legal): send their PO text and any uploaded DPA. I'll check for unusual audit/indemnity asks.
Nina (AE): pasted PO summary they uploaded to portal:

```
PO# SC-PO-2026-77
Amount: $24,000 (3-month reserved commit)
Instance: dedicated-4xA100
Billing request: quarterly invoicing / invoice at term start
Security: vendor-signed HSM attestation required; DPA redline attached by customer
Signature: DocuSign preferred to procurement@sigmacorp.com + legal@sigmacorp.com
```

Pri (Solutions): Important: Dedicated => BYO-KMS possible. For Hosted we'd only offer vendor-managed keys. Need to confirm which env POC will run in.
Lina (Security): We have a standard HSM attestation template (infra-signed). Can provide SOC2 excerpt + KMS diagram. For vendor-signed attestation we usually add a 1-page appendix to the DPA.
Omar (Finance): Quarterly invoicing for a 3-month order effectively means one invoice. That's OK but we need explicit payment terms (net-30) and a $10k exposure cap for trials.
Carlos (Legal): I'll prepare a DPA redline removing blanket subprocessor permissions and add an HSM attestation appendix. Also prefer countersign window of 4 business days.
Nina (AE): I'll confirm env (Dedicated) with SigmaCorp PM and confirm signer emails. They requested countersign within 5 business days on their side.
redwood-deploy-bot: infra-note: dedicated-4xA100 us-west-2 pool status: 18% spare for next 7 days.
Pri (Solutions): I'll draft a 1-page "POC orderform" (BOM: reserved hours, burst hours, monitoring credits, SLA bullets) to attach to the PO — helps procurement map costs.
Lina (Security): action: I'll upload attestation pdf to the portal once Legal confirms addendum language.
Omar (Finance): action: need the signed PO pdf + confirmation whether invoice should be a single upfront invoice or split. If single, mark as "invoice at term start; net-30".
Carlos (Legal): action: will post DPA redline + HSM addendum to portal by EOD and tag this thread.
Nina (AE): thanks — I'll post signer emails and the portal link here when I have them. Please @me when docs are ready. :thumbsup:
